title: Restore 12-hour time display
objective: Revert the user-visible time formatting introduced under FEEDBACK-09/11 from 24-hour back to 12-hour (user correction: time should be 12-hour, not 24-hour). Preserve internal ISO/time ordering, calendar wall calculations, local accounting overrides, sequence validation, and all source mutation protections.

supersedes.FEEDBACK-09: display24h helper and its call sites on CalendarImpact, Queue (scheduledRow.start, scheduledStart, droppedTimeLabel), and ApprovalDrawer exact-write times are reverted to display12h. FEEDBACK-09's 24-hour display claim is superseded; its other behaviors (ignored-source filter, accounting action model, projection-only local override, hard-block badge) are untouched and re-verified green.
supersedes.FEEDBACK-11: browser checks S3b (exact writes 24h) and S6r (queue scheduled time 24h) and S5a (calendar times 24h) asserted the superseded presentation; this task corrects the display format. FEEDBACK-11's method/retention/safety evidence remains valid except where it claims 24-hour compliance.

design_authority: User correction (handoff): time should be 12-hour, not 24-hour. display12h is the authoritative user-facing formatter (ported from the wizard, previously retained for Rail/SetupDrawer/ExecutionView/AnchoredEditor/exportPrompt/anchored warnings).
acceptance_criteria_met: Calendar impact, queue scheduled rows, day setup/results drawers, and exact-write displays use 12-hour format with AM/PM where applicable: CalendarImpact start/end ('9:30 AM-10:20 AM', '10 AM-10:30 AM'), Queue scheduledRow.start ('12:30 PM', '10:45 AM'), recurring scheduledStart ('fixed · recurring · 12:30 PM'), droppedTimeLabel (ISO -> compact 12h 'dropped 8 AM'), ApprovalDrawer exact-write times ('schedule · Pick up prescription @ 4 PM', 'create-event · Magic Mirror @ 10:45 AM'); SetupDrawer and Results panels were already display12h and are re-verified.

Internal ordering and arithmetic remain unchanged and timezone-safe: no edits to store/controller/allocator/overflow/wire; toHHMM/toMinutes/addMinutes/to24h untouched; sort keys, wall calculations, and sequence validation byte-identical (full frontend suite 572 passed, backend untouched).

Focused frontend tests, typecheck, build, and bounded scratch checks pass: focused 48 passed; full suite 37 files passed | 1 skipped, 572 passed | 6 skipped; typecheck clean; build:mockup + build:prod pass; rebuilt bundles read back containing the 12h AM/PM formatter; scratch :8790 served the rebuilt bundle GET-only with zero errors and was stopped.

FEEDBACK-11 evidence is superseded without claiming 24-hour compliance: this artifact supersedes the FEEDBACK-09/11 24-hour display claims; FEEDBACK-11 historical evidence is left intact and is not cited as 24-hour-compliant.
No live POST calls, calendar writes, runtime restart, external writes, or commit: safety_proof below.

changes.behavior: Remove display24h (FEEDBACK-09 helper) and its comment; display12h remains the single authoritative display formatter. Wire helpers (toMinutes/toHHMM/addMinutes/blocksLabel/compactDuration/minutesToBlocks) untouched.

display24h -> display12h for row start/end readouts. All other FEEDBACK-09 behavior (ignored-source filter + note, hard-block badge, accounting action model, local stepper, 'today only · event untouched') unchanged.

display24h -> display12h for scheduledRow.start and recurring scheduledStart; droppedTimeLabel renders a compact 12-hour label via display12h (ISO date parsed locally, then formatted). Ordering/sort logic untouched.
display24h suite replaced with display12h contract suite: AM/PM suffixes, noon/midnight as 12, zero-padded minutes, null/empty em dash.
CalendarImpact time assertions flipped to 12h ('9:30 AM-10:20 AM', '10 AM-10:30 AM'); removed the no-AM/PM guard, asserts AM/PM presence instead; projection test asserts 12h event readout unchanged.
New FEEDBACK-12 describe: scheduled row start 12h, recurring scheduledStart 12h, dropped row label 12h (timezone-robust regex).
New FEEDBACK-12 describe: expanded exact-write rows render AM/PM times, never 24h.

preserved_semantics: Wire format stays 24h HH:MM (server contract); to24h parser in adapters/wire.ts untouched.
Chronological ordering (FEEDBACK-01) unchanged: sort keys and controller sort untouched.

Calendar walls (FEEDBACK-02), overflow/infeasibility (FEEDBACK-03), quarantined classification (FEEDBACK-04), fixture scenarios (FEEDBACK-05), zero-writer envelope (FEEDBACK-06) all re-verified in the full suite.
Local accounting override (FEEDBACK-09) is projection-only: event start/end readout renders 12h but the stored source row is untouched; saveAnchoredOverride wire shape unchanged.
Export prompt and anchored warning copy keep display12h as before (retained non-affected surfaces).
